name: Bio Tank
text: Behaviors over hardcoding. Bubbles merge, munchers almost flock, meat eaters keep the tank self-regulating. Emergent and pretty — hit tab for debug stats.

name: All We Are Is Grok in the Wind
text: Custom white-noise machine: sixteen band-pass channels, per-band gain and slow LFOs. My windy background for days — randomize, tweak, save to JSON.

name: Geocentric Heliocentric with Orbit Trails
text: Geocentric vs heliocentric with dynamic orbit trails. Started from a one-line Grok prompt — solar_system_earth_to_sun — and grew from there.

name: War of the Planetoids
text: Arcade duel that's been on my mind for years. Circles became shapes, an AI opponent kept pace, and the sound is all HTML5 audio.
